run_inpaint_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionInpaintPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image guided by a text prompt
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_for_inpainting: prepare initial latents from an image and noise timestep using the prepare_latents method
prepare_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents for inpainting using the prepare_mask_latents method
encode_vae_image: encode a PIL image or tensor into VAE latent space using the _encode_vae_image method
